_doc: Trainer card badge page (v165_fixes 2026-10-11, b2tools/patches/trainer_card.py): Hoenn's Gym Leaders in Sapphire's badge order. Line 65+3k: city and name, 66+3k: the leader's motto from Sapphire's Gym sign, 67+3k: a line the leader says in Sapphire; 89+3k: the badge's name (Black 2's obedience lines after it are kept: they describe Black 2's own rule, which the game uses).

system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.67: By battling many Trainers, you should\nlearn many things.
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.70: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.73: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung Trainer like you!
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.75: One with a fiery passion that burns!
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.76: Your power reminds me of someone...
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.78: A man in pursuit of power!
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.79: I will do everything in my power as\na Gym Leader to win.
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.81: The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.
system/0379_btl_server_flow.txt.82: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to Bird Pokémon.
